awards.title: Global Champion, D3CODE 2025
awards.summary: UST's international student innovation challenge on AI, quantum computing and data ecosystems drew more than 25,000 students from Malaysia, India, Mexico, the United Kingdom and the United States. The Grand Jury named team Neural Navigators (Nagur Shareef Shaik, Georgia State University; Vandna Rajpal, Stevens Institute of Technology) the global winner for PRISM, an AI platform for no-code data analysis, ETL and predictive modeling.
